name: plan-meter
description: A band above the prompt with how far your plan file is (phases and steps done, what is in progress, what is next) and Claude's own task list, kept current as files change. Starts off: /plan-meter on turns it on

plan.title: Plan files
plan.description: Comma-separated paths, relative to the project, tried in order. A * in any part matches anything; the newest match wins.

refreshSeconds.title: Re-read every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the plan is read again, to catch edits made outside Claude Code. At least 5.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: on: the band shows while the mod is on. off: the mod works without a band, and /plan-meter answers with the plan's progress. /plan-meter on and off switch the whole mod, for every session.
